value: The quest brings the search to VanCleef’s ship, hidden within the mine. Dark timber and rigging stand against the enclosing rock; the Brotherhood’s stronghold has become a vessel held far from open water. The composition follows the dungeon’s recognizable setting while leaving its exact scale, position, and deck arrangement to the game rather than the illustration.
editorNote: The ship and Deadmines setting are supported; the illustration’s interior placement and dimensions are interpretive.
